Setup.Name: Use NameFormatter and ValueConverter
Setup.Description: A simple example on how to use a NameFormatter and a ValueConverter when parsing a json document.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Use name formatter and value converter"
    Description: "Renames the signal name be using camel case and converts the value from fahrenheit to celsius."
    Mqtt: 
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/temperature/+"
    Otel:
      Metrics:
        - Instrument: Gauge
          NameFormatter: "ToCamelCase([Name])"
          ValueConverter: "([Value] -32) * 5/9"
          ParseAs: 
             Type: Json
